item: The five Wikidata loaders and the Hugging Face release check refuse a redirect off their host, and a refused source-typing lookup is counted
key_paths: src/analytics/wikidata_rings.py; src/catalog/wikidata_enrich.py; src/catalog/wikidata.py; src/catalog/wikidata_apply.py; src/monitoring/release_run.py; tests/test_session_host_list.py; docs/SECURITY.md
summary: Follow-up to #1393, whose independent read found six of the eleven unlisted sessions were fixed API endpoints, not CDN redirectors. The five Wikidata loaders (src/catalog/wikidata_apply.py, src/entities/items.py, src/entities/gazetteer_build.py, src/analytics/ring_loader.py behind wikidata_rings.API_HOSTS / wikidata_enrich.API_HOSTS = www.wikidata.org, and the SPARQL query in src/catalog/discover.py behind wikidata.WDQS_HOSTS = query.wikidata.org) and the Hugging Face weights-digest check (release_run.HF_API_HOSTS = huggingface.co) now pass their endpoint's host as allowed_hosts, so a redirect off it, on the first request or any hop, raises RedirectRefused before it is sent. Exact hosts, not a family suffix: the sandbox cannot reach the three hosts, so the lists come from the URLs the code builds and SECURITY.md says so; a redirect inside a family would be refused loudly rather than followed. Each list is pinned EQUAL to its endpoint's host by a test, and each end-to-end test reads the list of the session the module built. UNLISTED_SESSIONS shrinks to the five modules with request-chosen or moving hosts (the installer's api.github.com lookup is a fixed endpoint still unlisted, and its row says so) and its test fails on an empty reason. The source-typing pass (wikidata_apply.apply_source_types) now counts a source whose lookup was refused (sources_refused, with the class name only) where it used to skip it as 'no match', and the Diagnostics button shows 'N refused'. SECURITY.md names the release run's one in-app huggingface.co read. One independent read: 0 block, 4 should-fix, 7 low, folded. Carried from the check of #1393: the parser-split test asserts its premise, and the one-reading cases cover a reading with no host and a percent in one reading only. Tests: one end-to-end test per module through its own default getter, and a test that each list equals the host of its endpoint and a neighbour is refused.
